stem: The expression \((3x - 1)^{2} - (x + 2)^{2}\) is equivalent to \(ax^{2} + bx + c\), where \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) are constants. What is the value of \(a + b + c\)?
solution: Shortcut: \(a + b + c\) is the value of the expression at \(x = 1\): \(2^{2} - 3^{2} = -5\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
e = expand((3*x - 1)**2 - (x + 2)**2)
p = Poly(e, x)
assert sum(p.all_coeffs()) == -5 and e.subs(x, 1) == -5
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [-5]
